This build (Nov 26): your picks and the Tester's Kit

how: Powers menu: cast Tester's Kit. Try each menu: a class at a tier, the relics, the night now and at 15, god mode, endless magicka and stamina, +50,000, 10 and 30 of the dead, a trial.
look: Each choice does what it says, and Back and Escape return to the menu. If a button does the wrong thing, say which: it is the first time the game's own message boxes are used.

how: With the kit, each class at Base, I, II, III and Ascend 1; the relics, the Tablet weapons and the wonders.
look: Each wears the look and colour you picked here, matching its preview.

t: Your ability picks in the game
how: Each weapon's hits, heavies and specials on 10 of the dead.
look: Each plays the option you picked in your colour, size, brightness, speed, linger, density and light. Area changes how far it reaches.

how: Volsung's heavy, the javelin's throw, the Bonereaper's kill.
look: Volsung: no smoke left after the blast. Javelin: only the javelin in the air, nothing until it lands. Bonereaper: Skyrim's summon flash where it rises.

how: Draw, swing and hit with any weapon (Skyrim's or ours), throw flasks, use the abilities.
look: Weapon and flask sounds sit in the background; each ability plays the sound you picked; the Mutagen Staff's flasks use the flask sounds.

how: Light and power attacks with a sword, a greatsword and a dagger on the dead.
look: Sword: a short hold on hits, longer on heavies with a little shake. Greatsword: a bit more. Dagger: none. A power attack that kills throws the body.

how: Hit the dead, take headshots, finish a night.
look: No crosshair mark or tick on hits or headshots (and no head burst on a headshot kill); the kill's own sound stays; the night's last kill in slow motion.

how: The Dead menu: each of the four trials at one city.
look: Restless: 8 m ring, 15 to 40 by difficulty, Ghost wail and Ethereal call. Whisper: 5 m, Ethereal call when found. Hold the Light: ring from 20 m in blue, Circle of Protection while inside, Subsonic when you step out. Seals: Glass jaw when one breaks.

how: Night 15 with 30 of the dead, then more.
look: No stutter the first time each effect goes off; bodies cleared past 12; fewer particles past 30 of the dead near you.
